contexts.text: They drew out... Joseph from the pit = aid from them, so that he should not be among falsities. To draw out and cause to ascend = to deliver, thus to render aid.
Intellectual things arise from sensuous ones by a method of drawing out...
From the scientifics... which remain, there is effected as it were an extraction, and... as it were sublimation, whence comes the interior sense of things...
Because I drew him out of the waters () = deliverance from falsities.
The drawing out of such things from the sense of the letter of the Word. Signified.
To pluck off = to draw out.
How the Spiritual Angels draw out their own sense, and the Celestial Angels theirs, from the natural sense. Example(s).
Every man draws out and gathers him into his net ()... = that then all falsity and evil can draw them to its own side.
To be drawn out on the Sabbath day () = to be instructed, and thus led out of them.

The old cast clouts and rotten rags with which they drew Jeremiah out () = the vindication of the truth of doctrine and restitution by such goods and truths of the sense of the letter of the Word as were not perceived and understood, and were therefore neglected and rejected.
To draw out with prickles () = to withdraw from truths by means of scientifics from the Word and the world falsely applied; and to draw out with fishing-hooks = by the fallacies of the sense.
Her days shall not be prolonged ().
